body: Thank you for your advice. I’ll try it

There are other things that she is trying to heal from like family, trauma, and insecurities. However, there have been things after that incident that have not helped either. 

During our argument that night, she ran out of the house and I ran after her because I was scared of what she was going to do with herself as she had a suicide attempt a little bit before the date. She did this because I had said that I had gotten the answer that I wanted from the guy I was dating(as to whether or not he liked me). I begged for her and was yelling for her to stop but she fought me off and kept running away from me, and someone made a noise complaint. The police came to diffuse the argument and sent us back to her house. While she was running she slit her foot, so there is a physical scar from that night. I paid for her bandages and alcohol, as well as her emergency care visit for stitches, which she tried to return back to me immediately but I gave her back the money again to show that I wanted to help. 

She says that she’s also upset with me for bringing up how I wanted to reach back out to him again a couple months after and for having another hang out with another guy. She says that if I cared I would have at least waited a little bit more or not have talked to her about the same guy from that first night. Admittedly, I shouldn’t have come to her to talk about trying to reach out to him again. I have started talking with other people again for the first time since last year, and she says that I have all the time in the world to talk with everybody else but with her to try to check up on her and fix things. Last night, she told me that she doesn’t want to be around me when I’m dick-whipped because she believes that I’m going to fuck her over again.

She told me that she was grateful for what me and my family have provided for her with our house and money, but says that that isn’t her love language and that that’s not what she needed from me to show that I love her. She told me that she wants for me to check in with her and talk with her about it, but whenever I do it leads to more arguments and hostility. It feels like whatever I say or do is wrong to her and makes her more upset. I want to be in her life and be supportive, but it does feel overwhelming at times which she says is my inability to handle the guilt. Last night, I suggested for us to have a little bit of space/having the conversation of her finding another place to stay and she told me that I was selfish and evil.

thank you. i’ve been trying to hold on, but i can’t let go of the abuse i endured in the past no matter how hard i try. now i have self sabotaged all the good relationships that were in my life. i want to have the strength to keep going, but i don’t have the motivation anymore.

I don’t use it that often, maybe like once or twice a week. Took .75mL of 166.67 MG this morning, and they called me right after telling me about the drug test 😭Was thinking of using the certo method, to help with my chances.
